Messages.Author: Chester DuBois
Messages.Body:
Hi everybody,

Two questions again, I didn't find the answer on the white wolf rulings and
errata sections so I post here.

1. Chiropteran Marauder & The Path of Metamorphosis
Path of Metamorphosis says: "Tzimisce burn one less blood". Can I use this
effect when playing Chiropteran Marauder at superior to avoid paying the
blood cost?

2. Yitzak.
His special power states: "Yitzak may tap a younger vampire as a (D) action.
If successful, that vampire does not untap as normal during his or her next
untap phase".
Can Yitzak use his special power and mmake the (D) action on a already
tapped vampire?
If he does, the action fizzles? Can the vampire untap the next untap phase?

Thanks,
Chester DuBois.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chester DuBois wrote:
> Hi everybody,
>
> Two questions again, I didn't find the answer on the white wolf rulings and
> errata sections so I post here.
>
> 1. Chiropteran Marauder & The Path of Metamorphosis
> Path of Metamorphosis says: "Tzimisce burn one less blood". Can I use this
> effect when playing Chiropteran Marauder at superior to avoid paying the
> blood cost?

No. Only card costs are affected.
The cost of a card is the number printed in the red blood drop.
The cost of other effects are not affected by the Path.

> 2. Yitzak.
> His special power states: "Yitzak may tap a younger vampire as a (D) action.
> If successful, that vampire does not untap as normal during his or her next
> untap phase".
> Can Yitzak use his special power and mmake the (D) action on a already
> tapped vampire?

Yes. The target could even be a tapped vampire in torpor.

> If he does, the action fizzles? Can the vampire untap the next untap phase?

No. No (at least, not with the "normal" untap during the untap phase).
